headline: A great defensive play for KC!
what_happened: K.Fulton caught the ball from D.Jones, which is called an interception and gives the ball to our team, the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is great news for us because it stops their attack and gives us a chance to score. Our odds of winning just went up by 15 percentage points.
pop_culture: This big play helped set up a touchdown for Travis Kelce on our next turn with the ball.
